Marta (PM): FYI 1: updated cut proposal after partner roadmap chat. need a quick check that we didn't undercommit.
Jon (Eng): what's changed?
Marta (PM): partner asked for live audit streaming and per-route cost-breakdown in console. partner is high-touch but not GA. Ops still wants SSO. proposal: keep live streaming in v1, but give partner a limited pilot stream (one tenant) for MVP. add a per-route cost snapshot (not full history) to the console for MVP.
Ivy (Security): pilot stream ok with scoped credentials and egress firewall. need an exception ticket.
Arun (ML): per-route cost snapshot is just aggregations of tokens and model used for the last 24h; low complexity.
Jon (Eng): implementation notes: cost snapshot card ~2 days, pilot streaming opt-in path reuse webhook ~3 days plus cert automation.
Kai (Design): I'll make a compact cost card for the console and a simple trust banner for pilot streaming.
Marta (PM): lock in cut: MVP = per-route 24h snapshot + partner pilot stream (single-tenant opt-in). v1 = full audit search, history, and multi-tenant streaming.
Scope-bot: Updated milestone: MVP_locked_date set.
Ivy (Security): open exception request now. need partner contact info.
Jon (Eng): can start cost card tomorrow.
Arun (ML): note: streaming PII redaction must be enforced on the pipeline. will provide a checklist.
Marta (PM): good. I'll coordinate partner comms and ship the partner playbook.
Jon (Eng): ETA for MVP items: cost card + design + tests = 3 days; streaming pilot gating + certs = 4-5 days pending security slot.
Marta (PM): ok proceeding. will update milestone tracker and notify partner of expected pilot timeline.
Jon (Eng): posting PR when ready. :computer:
Marta (PM): thanks all. keeping this thread as daily cadence until cut closes.
